asse"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"mbly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports

The old "n"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"o editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD v"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"iewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the re"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"sident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"|
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawin"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"g strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-c"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"ad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edge"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"s / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Par"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"ametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-ed"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"ge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take *"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"*curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not "},{"id":"p11s17","text":"a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or"},{"id":"p11s18","text":" planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one co"},{"id":"p11s19","text":"ntinuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The plugin is published to npm — one line:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automat"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ically, so there is nothing to configure by hand."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Version requirements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
the badge row above and"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
the prose so they never go stale"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
(cadorange over th"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed o"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nly on service
restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<wo"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"rkspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
are restored by replay after a restart
- **D"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"rawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
`npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT r"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"emoval, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidd"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"en-line
removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
without MEMFS, t"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"essellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
`hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. "},{"id":"p20s10","text":"Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame."},{"id":"p20s11","text":" Kernel
dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
`occt.ts` dependen"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"cy (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/."},{"id":"p20s13","text":"./opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint"},{"id":"p20s14","text":" solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
**`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, singl"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"e package ~538KB, zero deps) —
installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wa"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"sm` alone
upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
Resolution: th"},{"id":"p20s17","text":"e npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node."},{"id":"p20s18","text":" The solver speaks one JSON envelope
contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`"},{"id":"p20s19","text":") surfaced
verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
degrees) map bidirection"},{"id":"p20s20","text":"ally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability"},{"id":"p20s21","text":" is staged
(point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs

- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge se"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lection is unstable under

- Sketch extrusion supports polygon pr"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ofiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
panel itself) does not respond t"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"o components registered later, so the persistent
view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot,"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" the official composition)
